# @14ch/svelte-ui

Svelte 5 UI component library. Material Design inspired, accessibility-first.
Supports dark mode, high-contrast mode, and i18n (en/ja/fr/de/es/zh-cn).

## Installation

```bash
npm install @14ch/svelte-ui
```

Import the stylesheet in your root layout:

```svelte
<!-- src/routes/+layout.svelte -->
<script>
  import '@14ch/svelte-ui/styles';
</script>
```

## Global Configuration

```typescript
// src/lib/config.ts or app entry point
import { setSvelteUiConfig } from '@14ch/svelte-ui';

setSvelteUiConfig({
  locale: 'ja',           // 'en' | 'ja' | 'fr' | 'de' | 'es' | 'zh-cn'
  useBrowserLocale: true  // auto-detect from browser when locale is not set
});
```

## Dark Mode

Set `data-theme="dark"` on the `<html>` element to enable dark mode.

```html
<html data-theme="dark">
```

---

## Components

### Button

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button } from '@14ch/svelte-ui';
</script>

<Button onclick={() => console.log('clicked')}>Label</Button>
<Button variant="filled" size="small" loading={isLoading}>Submit</Button>
<Button variant="outlined" icon="add" fullWidth>Add Item</Button>
<Button href="/page">Link Button</Button>
```

Props: `variant` ('ghost'|'filled'|'outlined'|'glass'), `size` ('small'|'medium'|'large'), `icon` (Material Symbols name), `loading`, `disabled`, `fullWidth`, `rounded`, `popup`, `href`, `color`, `align`

---

### Icon

Uses [Material Symbols](https://fonts.google.com/icons). Pass the icon name as children.

```svelte
<Icon>home</Icon>
<Icon size={32} filled>settings</Icon>
```

### IconButton

```svelte
<IconButton ariaLabel="Close" onclick={handleClose}>close</IconButton>
<IconButton variant="filled" size={40}>edit</IconButton>
```

### Fab (Floating Action Button)

```svelte
<Fab icon="add" ariaLabel="Add" onclick={handleAdd} />
<Fab icon="add" position="bottom-right" />
```

---

### Input

```svelte
<Input bind:value={text} placeholder="Enter text" />
<Input bind:value={num} type="number" decimalPlaces={2} />
<Input bind:value={pw} type="password" enablePasswordVisibilityToggle />
<Input bind:value={url} linkify />
<Input bind:value={text} unit="kg" />
```

Props: `type` ('text'|'number'|'email'|'tel'|'password'|...), `inline`, `focusStyle` ('outline'|'background'|'none'), `fullWidth`, `clearable`, `linkify`, `unit`, `decimalPlaces`, `enableThousandsSeparator`, `enablePasswordVisibilityToggle`, `enableNumberStepper`

### Textarea

```svelte
<Textarea bind:value={text} placeholder="Enter text" />
<Textarea bind:value={text} autoResize maxHeight={300} />
<Textarea bind:value={text} clearable linkify />
```

### Select

```svelte
<script>
  const options = [
    { label: 'Option A', value: 'a' },
    { label: 'Option B', value: 'b' },
  ];
</script>

<Select bind:value={selected} {options} placeholder="Select..." />
```

### Combobox

Text input with dropdown suggestions.

```svelte
<Combobox bind:value={val} options={['Apple', 'Banana', 'Cherry']} filterable />
```

### ColorPicker

```svelte
<ColorPicker bind:value={hex} clearable />
<!-- value is a hex string e.g. "#ff0000" -->
```

### Checkbox

```svelte
<Checkbox bind:value={checked}>Label</Checkbox>
<Checkbox bind:value={partial} indeterminate>Partial</Checkbox>
```

### CheckboxGroup

```svelte
<script>
  const options = [
    { label: 'A', value: 'a' },
    { label: 'B', value: 'b' },
  ];
  let selected = ['a'];
</script>

<CheckboxGroup {options} bind:value={selected} />
```

### Radio / RadioGroup

```svelte
<!-- Individual radios sharing the same name -->
<Radio name="size" value="s" bind:currentValue={size}>Small</Radio>
<Radio name="size" value="m" bind:currentValue={size}>Medium</Radio>

<!-- Or use RadioGroup -->
<RadioGroup {options} bind:value={selected} />
```

### Switch

```svelte
<Switch bind:value={enabled} />
```

### Slider

```svelte
<Slider bind:value={num} min={0} max={100} step={1} />
```

### SegmentedControl

```svelte
<script>
  const items = [
    { label: 'Day', value: 'day' },
    { label: 'Week', value: 'week' },
    { label: 'Month', value: 'month' },
  ];
</script>

<SegmentedControl {items} bind:value={period} />
```

---

### Dialog

**IMPORTANT**: Do not manage open state from the parent. Use `bind:this` and call `ref.open()` / `ref.close()`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Dialog } from '@14ch/svelte-ui';
  let dialogRef;
</script>

<button onclick={() => dialogRef.open()}>Open</button>

<Dialog bind:this={dialogRef} title="Confirm" onClose={() => console.log('closed')}>
  Dialog body content here.
  {#snippet footer()}
    <button onclick={() => dialogRef.close()}>Close</button>
  {/snippet}
</Dialog>
```

Exported methods: `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`

### ConfirmDialog

Opinionated dialog with confirm/cancel buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  let confirmRef;
</script>

<button onclick={() => confirmRef.open()}>Delete</button>

<ConfirmDialog
  bind:this={confirmRef}
  title="Delete item?"
  description="This cannot be undone."
  danger
  onSubmit={handleDelete}
/>
```

Exported methods: `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`

### Drawer

```svelte
<script>
  let drawerRef;
</script>

<button onclick={() => drawerRef.open()}>Open Drawer</button>

<Drawer bind:this={drawerRef} title="Settings" position="right">
  Drawer content here.
</Drawer>
```

Exported methods: `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`

### Popup

Low-level popup anchored to an element. Use PopupMenu for menu use cases.

```svelte
<script>
  let anchorEl;
  let popupRef;
</script>

<button bind:this={anchorEl} onclick={() => popupRef.toggle()}>Toggle</button>

<Popup bind:this={popupRef} {anchorElement} position="bottom">
  Popup content here.
</Popup>
```

Exported methods: `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`, `getIsOpen()`

### PopupMenu

```svelte
<script>
  let anchorEl;
  let menuRef;

  const menuItems = [
    { label: 'Edit', icon: 'edit', callback: handleEdit },
    { label: 'Delete', icon: 'delete', callback: handleDelete },
    'separator',
    { label: 'Open page', icon: 'open_in_new', href: '/page' },
  ];
</script>

<button bind:this={anchorEl} onclick={() => menuRef.toggle()}>Menu</button>

<PopupMenu bind:this={menuRef} anchorElement={anchorEl} {menuItems} />
```

MenuItem type: `{ label: string, icon?: string, href?: string, callback?: () => void, disabled?: boolean }`

Exported methods: `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`

### PopupMenuButton

Pre-built three-dot menu button. No need to manage anchor element manually.

```svelte
<PopupMenuButton {menuItems} />
```

---

### Datepicker

```svelte
<Datepicker bind:value={date} />
<Datepicker bind:value={date} mode="range" />
<Datepicker bind:value={date} format="YYYY/MM/DD" locale="ja" hasIcon />
```

Exported methods: `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`

---

### Tab

Navigation tabs linked to URL paths.

```svelte
<script>
  const tabItems = [
    { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
    { label: 'Settings', href: '/settings' },
  ];
</script>

<Tab {tabItems} />
```

### Nav

Navigation menu. Supports horizontal, vertical, and mobile variants.

```svelte
<Nav
  navItems={[
    { label: 'Home', href: '/', icon: 'home' },
    { label: 'Settings', href: '/settings', icon: 'settings' },
  ]}
  variant="vertical"
/>
```

`variant`: 'tab' | 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'mobile'

### Pagination

```svelte
<Pagination
  total={200}
  limit={20}
  bind:currentPageNum={page}
  onchange={(p) => loadPage(p)}
/>
```

---

### Snackbar

Place `<Snackbar />` once in the root layout, then trigger from anywhere using the `snackbar` utility.

```svelte
<!-- src/routes/+layout.svelte -->
<Snackbar />
```

```typescript
import { snackbar } from '@14ch/svelte-ui';

snackbar.success('Saved successfully');
snackbar.error('Something went wrong');
snackbar.warning('Please check your input');
snackbar.info('New version available');
```

---

### FileUploader / ImageUploader

```svelte
<FileUploader bind:value={files} accept=".pdf,.docx" multiple />
<ImageUploader bind:value={images} accept="image/*" multiple previewStyle="framed" />
```

---

### Skeleton

Loading placeholder components.

```svelte
<SkeletonText lines={3} />
<SkeletonBox width={200} height={120} />
<SkeletonAvatar />
```

---

### LoadingSpinner

```svelte
<LoadingSpinner size={32} />
```

---

## Theme Customization

Override CSS variables in your global stylesheet. All public variables are prefixed with `--svelte-ui-`.

```css
:root {
  /* Primary color */
  --primary-500: #6750a4;
  --primary-600: #5b3d99;
  --primary-700: #4f2d8e;

  /* Or override directly */
  --svelte-ui-primary-color: #6750a4;
}
```

Key variables:
- `--svelte-ui-primary-color` — accent color used across interactive components
- `--svelte-ui-success-color`, `--svelte-ui-error-color`, `--svelte-ui-warning-color`
- `--svelte-ui-text-color`, `--svelte-ui-border-color`, `--svelte-ui-bg-color`

Component-level variables follow the pattern `--svelte-ui-{component}-{property}`, e.g. `--svelte-ui-button-border-radius`.
